title: Joomla 5.4.11 and 6.2.1 fix webservice ACL, Schema.org plugin and GET request task plugin flaws
date_note: The advisory pages give no publication day; 2026-11-24 is the fixed date they list.
geo_basis: project not tied to a stated location; map pin is a placeholder
summary: The Joomla! Security Centre lists fixes in 5.4.11 and 6.2.1 dated 2026-11-24. Three of them: read actions on webservice endpoints lacked a dedicated permission check (CVE-2026-120653); the Schema.org system plugin outputs the saved schema of unpublished and access-restricted items on error pages (CVE-2026-120655); the GET request task plugin stored fetched responses in a publicly accessible folder (CVE-2026-129380). The advisories say to upgrade.
plain: Joomla released versions 5.4.11 and 6.2.1 that fix three information-exposure flaws, including content that could be read without the right permission. Joomla's advisories say to upgrade.
exec: Joomla's advisories say three flaws could expose content to people who should not see it; the fix is to upgrade to 5.4.11 or 6.2.1.
action: Joomla advises upgrading to version 5.4.11 or 6.2.1.

sources.name: Joomla Security Centre: 20261143 GET request task plugin

validation.note: Joomla's own security advisories read in full; no exploitation is stated on the pages.

review.note: Compared title, fixed versions, three CVEs, descriptions, upgrade advice and dates with the three Joomla advisories
